# Third-party source

`space_view3d_point_cloud_visualizer.py` is the Point Cloud Visualizer Blender
add-on by Jakub Uhlik. Its upstream source is <https://github.com/uhlik/bpy>.
It is distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later, as
stated in the source file. This copy includes local compatibility changes for
Blender 5.1 and is kept in the repository so preview scripts do not depend on
an untracked file inside another submodule.
